question: Top 5 product categories by revenue in the last 90 days
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' AND DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Number of orders per month in 2025
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Percentage of order items returned, by product department
reference_sql: SELECT p.department, ROUND(100 * COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned') / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_pct FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY 1

question: Average order value by country, top 10
reference_sql: SELECT u.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which traffic source brought the most users?
reference_sql: SELECT traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Top 10 brands by total profit
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), 2) AS profit FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

question: Average delivery time in hours from order creation to delivery, for delivered orders
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(delivered_at, created_at, HOUR)), 2) AS avg_delivery_hours FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL

question: Percentage of orders in each status
reference_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` GROUP BY 1

question: How many users signed up each year?
reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS year, COUNT(*) AS users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which distribution center shipped the most order items?
reference_sql: SELECT dc.name, COUNT(*) AS items_shipped FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON p.distribution_center_id = dc.id WHERE oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total revenue in the last 30 days
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE status = 'Complete' AND DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

question: Number of users by gender
reference_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1

question: Top 5 countries by number of users
reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS users FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Average customer age by traffic source
reference_sql: SELECT traffic_source, ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1

question: Number of website events by event type
reference_sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS events FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.events` GROUP BY 1

question: Top 5 browsers by number of sessions
reference_sql: SELECT browser, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.events` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 10 product categories by average retail price
reference_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(retail_price), 2) AS avg_retail_price FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many products does each department have?
reference_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS products FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` GROUP BY 1

question: Average number of items per order, by order status
reference_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(num_of_item), 2) AS avg_items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` GROUP BY 1

question: Revenue by product department in the last 365 days
reference_sql: SELECT p.department, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' AND DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY) GROUP BY 1
